title: Vivino Wine Scan Vivino Rating Leaderboard
dataSources: CellarTracker bottles (`cellartracker:bottle`), Vivino wines (`vivino:wine`), spirits bottles (`spirit:bottle`), and wine tasting notes (`wine:tasting`).
app: CellarTracker bottle exports, Vivino wine scans, spirits inventory logs, and tasting note journals forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vivino:wine vivino_rating=*
| stats sum(vivino_rating) as total_value, avg(vivino_rating) as avg_value by wine_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks wine values by total and average vivino rating across Vivino wine scan events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `vivino_rating` values for each Vivino wine scan event and review total and average vivino rating by wine.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total vivino rating.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which wine shows the biggest vivino rating numbers in your Vivino wine scan data.
